answer.summary: All 10 PlayerApiTest cases in the WithValidUrlAccessControlCookie nested class fail with HTTP 404 where 200 is expected. The failure repeats in both Maven runs (Run 1 and Run 2), so it does not look like a flake. The log shows ElementNotFoundException but not which element is missing. The change touches OpenCRQ/XtmOne code, not the player API, so the link to the change is unproven. The unrelated warnings (Maven 401s, Shibboleth timeouts, ES mapping error) look like noise. Rerunning is unlikely to pass; check the player endpoint and its test data.
